title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. I am writing to you again to kindly request your ruling on a Khula that has been issued in my marriage. I had emailed you long ago but did not receive a response. I'll appreciate your quick response for this attempt. My wife had conducted herself in questionable manner during the initial 5 months of our marriage. She was careless about expenses and her social life. I requested her to control herself but she mostly responded with anger as she was brought up with complete freedom of her parents, who also expected me to change for her unconditionally. Noticing that I was unwilling to change for her, she isolated herself and overanalyzed our marriage before approaching an Imam and requested a Khula...??? 3535 views Q. My friend's niece in writing divorced to her husband. Is this divorce valid or void? Please reply. 1814 views Q. I have a very serious problem to discuss with you.My husband divorced me thrice (verbally) in one sitting just 4 months back.I am a working lady.I am very ashamed that I did not follow the rules of iddah strictly as prescribed by the Shariah. Though I did not indulge in any immoral and bad activity nor I contracted marriage with anybody during the whole period of iddah but one mistake I commited is that I couldn?t confine myself within the boundaries of my house and went outside during my iddah due to my job and some other domestic reasons for which I am feeling very guilty today as I have gone through some Islamic material (after the completion of my Iddah) about the rules of Iddah and found myself deviating the rules as prescribed by Islam.I repent and admit my sin and Pray to ALLAH to forgive me...? 5541 views Q. Divorce 2581 views Q. Yesterday during an argument wit my wife and she asked for talaq suddenly not knowing its result ...i told her that (achcha ab mai tumhe talaq deraha hu bas ek bar bolo ki tume sach main talaq chahiye) my intention was that i am am about to give talaq to her if she asks again... but the words in URDU carry some other meaning... Now did the TAlaq happen and also how to lower her temperament.. 4253 views Q. How to live with it? 1658 views Q. Agreement on child custody in khula 12151 views Q. I had several heated arguments and fights with my wife in the past 2 years or so we have been married. We have 2 kids masha Allah. I dont recall what I said to her most of the times exactly but never told her or even thought about giving talak. Once I did tell her though that she need to call her parents and tell them to come and take her back to their house. I have also many times in these fights to her that if she is not happy with me she has the option to leave me but it will not be done by me to ask her to leave. The frequency of these fights have gone down significantly to almost none now alhamdulillah. 2701 views Q. if any muslim person divorce his wife thrice times after that she will remains her wife his wife or not if he wnts keep her as wife 1914 views Q. answer: Social Matters >> Talaq (Divorce) Question ID: 35074 Country: Canada Title: My question is that I pronounced one talaq to my wife as an intention of talaq-e-raja'i that I will make ruju with her until end of three menses Question: My question is that I pronounced one talaq to my wife as an intention of talaq-e-raja'i that I will make ruju with her until end of three menses but at the same time I decided not to inform her about my intention. Before completing three months I showed her my private part through Skype video and also I saw her breast (not her private part). Unfortunately, I could not make ruju with her in first three menses due to her bad behavior. After 6, months she told me that "the ruju already happened when we saw each other through Skype". My question is that is it true whatever she said? In fact, I too had the intention of ruju when I was showing her my privet part as I mentioned above but I was in doubt about the validity of Skype camera whether Shariah considers it a real showing or not. Please satisfy me whether I have to make fresh nikah with her to make ruju or I have already made it as my wife says? Answer ID: 35074 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1759/1416/B=1432) Your raja't was not complete as per the Shariah merely by showing your private parts to your wife and seeing your wife's breast through Skype videos. It is necessary to have new nikah in order to reestablish the marital life with her after the iddah is over. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
